items.prompt: A server room aisle in near darkness: tall racks of machines with tiny status lights, thick cooling pipes overhead, heat shimmer in the air. At the far end, a single anonymous engineer stands looking at it all.

alt.ru: Проход машинного зала в полутьме: высокие стойки с огоньками, толстые трубы охлаждения, в конце прохода стоит инженер.
alt.en: A server-room aisle in near darkness: tall racks with tiny lights, thick cooling pipes, an engineer standing at the far end.
alt.pt: Um corredor de sala de servidores na penumbra: bastidores altos com pequenas luzes, tubos de refrigeração, um engenheiro ao fundo.
alt.es: Un pasillo de sala de servidores en penumbra: bastidores altos con lucecitas, gruesas tuberías de refrigeración, un ingeniero al fondo.

items.prompt: A white porcelain teacup with steam rising from it floats in black space, small against an enormous dark sphere whose edge is outlined by a thin bright ring of swirling light. The cup is about to cross the edge.

alt.ru: Фарфоровая чашка с паром парит в чёрном пространстве у края огромной тёмной сферы, обведённой тонким светящимся кольцом.
alt.en: A steaming porcelain cup floats in black space at the edge of a huge dark sphere ringed with thin light.
alt.pt: Uma chávena de porcelana fumegante flutua no espaço negro junto à borda de uma enorme esfera escura rodeada por um fino anel de luz.
alt.es: Una taza de porcelana humeante flota en el espacio negro junto al borde de una enorme esfera oscura rodeada por un fino anillo de luz.

items.prompt: An ordinary closed laptop on a plain wooden table, but glowing from within like a small star: white-hot light pouring from its seams, the table and the walls of the dark room lit by it as if by a furnace.

alt.ru: Обычный закрытый ноутбук на столе светится изнутри, как маленькая звезда: из щелей бьёт белый свет и освещает тёмную комнату.
alt.en: An ordinary closed laptop on a table glows from within like a small star, white light pouring from its seams into the dark room.
alt.pt: Um portátil fechado comum numa mesa brilha por dentro como uma pequena estrela, luz branca a sair das frestas para o quarto escuro.
alt.es: Un portátil cerrado corriente sobre una mesa brilla por dentro como una pequeña estrella, luz blanca saliendo por las juntas hacia la habitación oscura.
